verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI ships an extensively documented Python API (Agent class, tools, output_type, message history, MCP client, CLI clai, to_cli_sync) that lets developers/agents programmatically construct and run agents, confirmed by both first-party docs and community usage reports of building agents/integrations against it. Missing for 10: a dedicated REST/OpenAPI-style network API specifically for Pydantic AI (the openapi.json probe appears to be the docs site, not the library) and independent audit confirming full API-surface completeness beyond mixed community feedback.
